status: Registered before either continuation fit or development scores
hypothesis: Uniform frame H/A loss underweights brief control; explicit training-only whole-spell weighting may sharpen ownership, and doubling both live/dead loss contributions on missing-ball frames may improve occlusion decisions without a manual class-prior shift.
parent: Exact frozen boundary102 full65 checkpoint; same102s architecture and train-only normalizer; no new match or validation labels in fitting.
preparation: Regenerate all139 original training scenarios with current audited period-local feature pipeline. Original9 external converted games,20 approved SkillCorner caches,36 PFF geometry/reference receipts. Never reuse stale feature arrays.
control: Warm-start3000 steps with original loss. Same seed, batches, sampler, geometry, optimizer, boundary loss and initial weights as weighted model.

weighted_loss.live_spell_weight: clip(sqrt(10 / full training spell duration in seconds),1,4), H/A only, within independent periods, unknown excluded

sampling: Same equal four-provider sampling as parent, uniform games/scenarios/periods/windows; no selection by errors or development scores.
inference: Same50/50 boost/new-neural fusion. Each fit evaluated with original decoder and already-defined .4s/4.5 short decoder. No activity-expert/contact blend or further tuning in this study.
gate_reference: Both canonical and SDK-shadow, all ten natural and fixed blind scenarios; compare uniform vs parent and weighted vs parent AND matched uniform. Do not attribute extra-training gains to weighting.
prohibited: checkpoint selection or early stopping on development scores
limitations: Further adaptive development, not new independent validation. Any qualifying changed model needs technical regression and reproducible artifact generation; original holdout scores do not transfer to it.
